evidence_quotes: The original LST data are from the collection 6 MOD11A1 and MYD11A1 products with a 1-km spatial resolution downloaded from the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) website.
The monthly mean land surface temperature (LST) over the study period (2001–2018) is generated through a two-step strategy.
Based on the quality control flag, only data with LST errors less than 2 K are used.
First, the instantaneous temperature observations are converted to the daily mean temperature using a statistical-based method 44 .
Second, the daily average temperature is temporally aggregated to the monthly value using averaged by day (ABD) approach 45 and spatially aggregated to 0.05° resolution.

This method generates the daily mean LST for each pixel using the weighted mean value of different MODIS observation combinations (at least one daytime and one nighttime observation for both Aqua and Terra observations).

directions.research_question: 研究全球陆地植被持续变绿对地表温度的生物物理影响及其时空、季节差异，并评估这种影响对变暖的缓解程度，重点分析印度和中国等区域。研究对象是2001–2018年植被绿度变化与陆地表面温度之间的关系。
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 植被变绿会通过改变地表反照率以及水分蒸发和感热交换效率，调节辐射过程与非辐射过程，从而改变局地陆地表面温度，整体上产生降温效应。雪覆盖、植被绿度和短波辐射会通过改变辐射过程与非辐射过程的相对作用，控制温度敏感性的空间和季节差异。

evidence_quotes: this study demonstrates the first regional-scale implementation of the most recent version of the STIC model (STIC1.2) that integrates the Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) derived T R and ancillary land surface variables in conjunction with NLDAS (North American Land Data Assimilation System) atmospheric variables into a combined structure of the PM and Shuttleworth–Wallace (SW) framework for estimating ET at 1 km  ×  1 km spatial resolution.

Meteorological inputs were obtained from hourly NLDAS-2 (North American Land Data Assimilation System 2) forcing data (Xia et al., 2012). Daily meteorological variables, which were derived from hourly NLDAS and PRISM (Parameter-elevation Relationships on Independent Slopes Model; PRISM Climate Group, Oregon State University, http://prism.oregonstate.edu ) data, were obtained from the University of Idaho ( http://climate.nkn.uidaho.edu/METDATA/ ).

Half-hourly gridded meteorological datasets from the North American Land Data Assimilation System (NLDAS-2) at 4 km  ×  4 km spatial resolution were used as inputs in the STIC1.2 ( R S , T A , and RH) and SEBS ( u , R S , T A , and RH) models.

Additional inputs of daily meteorology ( R S , T A , u , and RH) required for computing 8-day ET were obtained from the University of Idaho ( http://climate.nkn.uidaho.edu/METDATA/ ), and these data products were derived from hourly NLDAS and PRISM datasets. Daily weather data were also aggregated to the corresponding MODIS 8-day periods.

evidence_quotes: this study demonstrates the first regional-scale implementation of the most recent version of the STIC model (STIC1.2) that integrates the Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) derived T R and ancillary land surface variables in conjunction with NLDAS (North American Land Data Assimilation System) atmospheric variables into a combined structure of the PM and Shuttleworth–Wallace (SW) framework for estimating ET at 1 km  ×  1 km spatial resolution.
Key remotely sensed data for model implementation were obtained from the MODIS Terra 8-day composites.

Broadband surface albedo was estimated using all the narrow band surface reflectances from MOD09A1, and NDVI (Tucker, 1979) was computed using near-infrared and red band surface reflectance of MOD09A1 products. T R  information was obtained from the MOD11A2 LST product for the study years.

For the image-based implementation of STIC1.2, we make a key adjustment to the original ecosystem-scale STIC1.2 version (Mallick et al., 2016) to apply the model at an instantaneous scale (i.e., MODIS image acquisition time) by removing the calculation of hysteresis occurrence using hourly data (Mallick et al., 2015). Such an adjustment was necessary to adapt the model to single time-of-day T R  data from the MODIS acquisition.
TR information was obtained from the MOD11A2 LST product for the study years.

directions.research_question: 该论文研究在美国本土跨干湿梯度的13个核心AmeriFlux站点及区域尺度上，基于影像实现的STIC1.2模型能否可靠估算1 km空间分辨率蒸散发（ET）。同时比较STIC1.2与SEBS和MOD16 ET在不同气候、生态系统条件下的表现。
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 核心机制是将辐射地表温度（TR）直接纳入Penman–Monteith方程，并通过解析求解空气动力导度、冠层导度和源/汇高度温度来避免经验参数化。论文假设TR反映的地表水分可用性可约束生物物理导度，从而改进区域ET估算。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 论文使用MODIS提供的辐射地表温度TR及辅助地表变量，并结合NLDAS大气变量作为STIC1.2区域ET估算输入；变量包括净辐射、地表反照率、发射率、NDVI、近地面气温、水汽压、饱和差等。13个核心AmeriFlux通量站观测ET用于验证STIC1.2结果。SEBS模型输出和MOD16 ET产品用于与STIC1.2的ET估算精度进行对比。
directions.method_paradigm: 方法范式为热红外遥感驱动的地表能量平衡/ Penman–Monteith物理模型反演，并进行通量塔验证与模型间比较。STIC1.2通过解析和迭代求解状态方程，对区域ET进行影像化估算。
directions.study_area: conterminous US；13 core AmeriFlux sites covering an aridity gradient
directions.study_period: 给定文本未明确给出具体年份；使用各站点的one wet, one dry, and one normal precipitation year，并评估8-day cumulative ET
